user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 1212 lux

期望 湿度 处于 48 % 到 68 %
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警

standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 1212 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 1212 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor

IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(pm2.5Density) >= 157 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(pm2.5Density) < 157 THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 68 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN motor_control(2) babai_curtain
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 45 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN motor_control(1) babai_curtain
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() > 68 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_dehumidifier

IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(RelativeHumidity) < 48 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN start_sweep() viomi_vacuum
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_diffuser
IF yunmi_water_purifier.tds_in() <= 89 THEN turn_on() yunmi_water_purifier
IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() >= 0.38 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() > 0.05 THEN turn_on() aqara_alarm
IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() > 0.05 THEN turn_on() chuangmi_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_dehumidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_diffuser
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() viomi_hood
